lessons.content:
Video 1.1: What is Safety and Why LOTO is Needed?

Bilingual Training Lesson (English + हिन्दी) | HSEdx LOTO Safety

EN

English Video Script & Learning

Hello everyone, welcome back. In this section, we will learn about what is safety and why loto is needed? as part of LOTO Safety Awareness. Safety means protecting people, equipment, property, environment and operations from harm. LOTO means Lockout Tagout and is used before maintenance, repair, servicing, cleaning, inspection and adjustment work. Lockout physically secures an energy isolation point; tagout gives warning and information. Unexpected energy can cause electric shock, crushing, burns, pressure injury, caught-in injury, amputation or fatality. Stopped equipment is not always safe; hazardous energy must be isolated and verified. The key message is: do not assume equipment is safe. Identify energy, isolate it, lock it, tag it, control stored energy and verify before work starts.

हिन्दी

हिन्दी व्याख्या एवं स्क्रिप्ट (Hindi)

सभी को नमस्कार, आपका फिर से स्वागत है। इस खंड में हम सीखेंगे कि सुरक्षा क्या है और LOTO की आवश्यकता क्यों है। मशीनरी और उपकरणों के रखरखाव, सर्विसिंग और सफाई के दौरान अगर मशीन अचानक चालू हो जाए तो भयानक दुर्घटनाएं होती हैं। LOTO का उद्देश्य खतरनाक ऊर्जा स्रोतों को बंद करके ताले से सुरक्षित करना है ताकि काम करने वाले श्रमिक पूरी तरह सुरक्षित रहें। मुख्य संदेश यह है: कभी भी यह न मानें कि उपकरण सुरक्षित है। ऊर्जा की पहचान करें, उसे अलग करें, ताला लगाएं, टैग लगाएं और जांच करें।

English Video Script & Learning

Hello everyone, welcome back. In this section, we will learn about meaning of hazardous energy as part of LOTO Safety Awareness. Hazardous energy is any energy that can harm people if released or uncontrolled. Energy may be electrical, mechanical, hydraulic, pneumatic, thermal, chemical, gravity or stored energy. Electrical energy can cause shock, burns, arc flash and fatality. Pressure energy can cause sudden movement, hose whipping and injection injury. Energy mapping identifies all energy sources and isolation points before LOTO is applied. The key message is: do not assume equipment is safe. Identify energy, isolate it, lock it, tag it, control stored energy and verify before work starts.

हिन्दी

Many LOTO incidents happen because important steps are missed. Common mistakes include poor preparation, missed energy sources, wrong isolation, shared locks, no verification and unsafe re-energisation. Do not depend only on stop buttons or emergency stops.
